limitations: Paid/PAP entry is not a new prescription: may include QuickStart transition or reactivation. QuickStart is excluded from the calibrated state.
Annual321net additions includingQuickStart cannot identify QuickStart conversion or abandonment without opening and ending QuickStart stocks.
Model assumes uniform monthly entries, exponential first-year survival, equal paid/free hazards, one-way free-to-paid transfer, and no reactivation. These simplify underidentified histories.
All opening patients use assumed prevalent retention; they are not known to be mature users.
PHVS scenarios are constant-activity five-year comparisons without origin depletion, launch ramp, changing competition or paid pricing. Cannot infer peak or fair value.
Population scenarios are provisional whole-market accounting, not clinically eligible PHVS TAM; no individual-injectable allocation is justified.
Acute-only proxy means treated minus LTP under a partition assumption; annual claims can overlap and do not directly identify point-in-time states.
No probability distribution or confidence interval is assigned to scenario ranges.
